notes:
U13 (issue #4 R3 motivating fixture, port-parity plan): three below-the-fold `
` elements ('Stand out, build trust, and...', 'Branded Call performance analytics', 'Secure Branding: Your Brand, Only on Verified Calls') start at opacity:0/translateY(40px). Redesigned per orchestrator direction to match the real IX2 mechanism: on `window.scrollY` threshold crossing, a `requestAnimationFrame` loop drives a 2000ms interpolation keyed on `performance.now()` (opacity 0->1, translateY 40px->0px, written as inline style each frame, overriding the CSS starting rule), finalizing to a one-way latch ('.is-revealed' marker, never reverts). No `Date`/`setTimeout`/wall-clock use anywhere in the script -- rAF + performance.now are both driven by matchy's page.clock virtual clock during capture, so the animation is deterministic by construction. Two of the three sections carry a below-fold, plain-src (no srcset), loading="lazy" already vendored in golden. OBSERVED on a full run with settle default-on (testbed/.runs/v24-scroll-reveal/diff-result.json, re-verified after the rAF redesign): status=pass, 0 issues, 0 warnings; both sides' bundles record determinism.settle="ran" and determinism.quiescence="reached" (no timeout) -- the deserved outcome, mirroring v13-render-equivalent's clean-pair shape (status pass, maxIssues 0, forbidden missing_*/visual_region_changed/style_changed/clickable_area_regressed). Full settle's quiescence wait (up to 5000ms, resets on every un-ignored mutation, including each per-frame inline-style write) comfortably outlasts the 2000ms animation plus its own quiet window, so every reveal completes before the screenshot. NEGATIVE CONTROL NOW WORKS (manual run, not wired into CI, per instructions -- observed in /tmp/claude-1000/v24-nosettle/diff-result.json): `--no-settle` forces `settleMode=legacy` (determinism.settle="skipped", quiescence="notRun", lazyLoadPass="ran" on both sides) -- legacy's coarser scroll-through (~100ms dwell/step, 250ms at the end) crosses the reveal thresholds late enough that the rAF animation is still mid-flight when the screenshot is taken. Result: status=warn, 10 issues -- 3 `style_changed` (warning, property=opacity, from=0.485 to=1, i.e. frozen ~48.5% into the 2000ms animation) + 7 `visual_region_changed` (info; 5 anchored to the three hidden sections' text -- 'THE SOLUTION'/'Identify patterns in call outcomes...' under the first two reveal sections, 'Display your brand only on verified calls'/'Secure Branding: Your Brand, Only on Verified Calls' under the third -- plus 2 unanchored region-level diffs). This is exactly the settle-earns-its-keep proof the fixture is meant to demonstrate; the earlier scrollY-latch-only design (superseded) could not produce this because legacy's own scroll-through was already sufficient to satisfy an instant, non-animated threshold latch.
